title: Regenerate the day-13 launch recap with real numbers
body:
The placeholder version (20260818_131109_proof.json) was rejected on 2026-08-18 rather than published with [DEMOS_BOOKED]/[DOCS_TRACKED]/[ALERTS_SENT] in it.

Regenerate it now, for Monday 31 Aug, with actuals pulled from the daily scan data:
  - demos booked -> leads.csv, demo_requested column
  - documents under alerting + alerts sent -> SmartPRO production

Structure to reuse (all still true as of 18 Aug): what shipped (bilingual email, day-count parity), what we caught first (our own expired OCCI certificate), what we fixed mid-launch (the wrong-document CR clause), what is still open (no reference number, English strings in Arabic mode).

Generating it fresh also resets the queue-hygiene clock: the 18 Aug draft sat 12.7 days old against the 14-day expire_stale cap, with 1.3 days of slack.
